name: navverse-benchmark
description: A benchmark suite for embodied navigation and instruction-following tasks in simulated (and/or recorded) environments intended to evaluate agents' ability to navigate, follow natural-language directions, and reason about spatial layouts. It measures end-to-end navigation success, path efficiency, and instruction compliance across multimodal inputs. Suitable for comparing navigation policies and multimodal models on practical robotics/navigation scenarios.
reputation: An emerging benchmark for navigation and embodied-agent evaluation with limited but increasing attention in the navigation/embodied-AI community.
